_comment: PDK version pin for the sky130-opamp gm/ID characterization harness
(issue #6). Same shape as the sibling sky130-ldo repo's sim/pdk.json
(and sky130-bandgap's, which that sibling itself follows), reused per
the issue's own scope note to borrow that harness convention rather
than invent a new one.
family            sky130 PDK family (via volare)
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (A/B differ in metal stack)
open_pdks_commit  the volare version hash every record in this experiment
is pinned against -- verified installed in this
environment at ~/.volare/sky130A (2026-09-08)
install_command   reproduces this exact install
default_pdk_root  fallback PDK_ROOT if neither $PDK_ROOT nor `volare path` resolve
ngspice_corner_dir directory holding the per-process-corner .spice include
files this harness points ngspice at directly (see
corners/README.md for why the harness includes
ngspice/corners/<corner>.spice rather than the combined
libs.tech/combined/sky130.lib.spice: a ~450x parse-time
difference for a bare-device sweep that never touches
the RF/ESD/bipolar/high-voltage model families the
combined library also pulls in)
process_corners   the five standard sky130 1.8V-core MOS process corners
-- confirmed against this pinned checkout's own
libs.tech/ngspice/corners/*.spice files (see
corners/model-files.json for the exact resolved
sky130_fd_pr__{nfet,pfet}_01v8__<corner>.*.spice paths).
This is the pointer spec/target-spec.md Section 1's
'Corner grid' row cites.
